rows.name: Writing of Liber AL — Chapter I
rows.about: The first of the Three Days (1904).
rows.practice: Hear or read Chapter I of the Book of the Law, traditionally at noon; open the three-day feast.

rows.name: Writing of Liber AL — Chapter II
rows.practice: Hear or read Chapter II; continue the feast.

rows.name: Writing of Liber AL — Chapter III
rows.practice: Hear or read Chapter III; close the Feast of the Three Days.

rows.name: Feast for the Prophet and his Bride
rows.about: A feast celebrating the union (the Prophet and his Bride, 1903).
rows.practice: Toast the Star and the Snake.

rows.name: The Prophet’s Nativity
rows.about: Crowley’s birthday (1875) — a feast of celebration and gratitude for the current.

rows.name: The Prophet’s Greater Feast
rows.practice: Commemorate death as a sacrament; a solemn feast.

rows.name: Vernal Equinox — Thelemic New Year
rows.about: The Equinox of the Gods / Feast of the Supreme Ritual.
rows.practice: Perform the Equinox ceremony and re-dedicate; the new year of the Aeon begins ({years} since 1904).

rows.name: Summer Solstice — Feast for Fire
rows.practice: A solar-maximum working and the noon adoration writ large.

rows.name: Autumn Equinox
rows.practice: Re-attune and rebalance; banish what the year has spent.

rows.name: Winter Solstice — Feast for Water
rows.practice: A vigil through the longest night.

rows.name: Imbolc / Candlemas
rows.about: A fire-festival of first stirrings and purification.

rows.name: Beltane
rows.about: The spring fire-festival of union and vitality.
rows.practice: A rite of joy and life-force.

rows.name: Samhain
rows.about: (eve of Oct 31 night) The festival of the dead and the thinning veil.
rows.practice: Honour ancestors, do underworld or Death-path work.

rows.name: New Moon in {sign}
rows.practice: Start a new working, plant intentions, banish and clear. A good night to open a lunar cycle of practice.

rows.name: Full Moon in {sign}
rows.practice: Invocations, charging talismans, the esbat. Work at the height of the tide by night.

rows.name: Sun enters {sign}
rows.practice: Begin the month’s work under {sign}’s nature.
